description: This file defines a set of React components and hooks for a sidebar UI element, including context management, responsive behavior, and various subcomponents like menu items, buttons, and layout wrappers.

methods.name: useSidebar
methods.description: Custom React hook to access sidebar context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: SidebarProvider
methods.description: Component that provides sidebar state and context, manages open/close state, cookies, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: Main sidebar component that renders differently based on device type and collapsibility settings.

methods.name: SidebarTrigger
methods.description: Button component to toggle the sidebar, with accessible label and icon.

methods.name: SidebarRail
methods.description: Button for toggling sidebar in rail mode, with resize cursor.

methods.name: SidebarInset
methods.description: Main content area for inset sidebar variant.

methods.name: SidebarInput
methods.description: Input component styled for sidebar use.

methods.name: SidebarHeader
methods.description: Header container for sidebar sections.

methods.name: SidebarFooter
methods.description: Footer container for sidebar sections.

methods.name: SidebarSeparator
methods.description: Visual separator component within sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarContent
methods.description: Content container for sidebar inner content.

methods.name: SidebarGroup
methods.description: Container for grouping sidebar items.

methods.name: SidebarGroupLabel
methods.description: Label for sidebar groups, supports child rendering.

methods.name: SidebarGroupAction
methods.description: Action button within sidebar group, positioned at top right.

methods.name: SidebarGroupContent
methods.description: Content area within a sidebar group.

methods.name: SidebarMenu
methods.description: List container for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuItem
methods.description: Individual menu item in sidebar.

methods.name: sidebarMenuButtonVariants
methods.description: CVA variants for styling sidebar menu buttons.

methods.name: SidebarMenuButton
methods.description: Button component for sidebar menu, supports tooltip and active state.

methods.name: SidebarMenuAction
methods.description: Action button for sidebar menu items, appears on hover or active.

methods.name: SidebarMenuBadge
methods.description: Badge indicator for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSkeleton
methods.description: Skeleton placeholder for loading sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSub
methods.description: Sub-menu list within sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubItem
methods.description: Item within a sidebar sub-menu.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubButton
methods.description: Button for sub-menu items, supports active state and child rendering.
